candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the AI Engineer internship. Designing RAG solutions that make an AI system more accurate is the exact problem I worked on in my latest project, DocuMind (github.com/Rayyan3079/documind-rag).
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I built data pipelines and dashboards on SAP platforms, including dashboards on machine and production data.

achievements.impact: I built a RAG system over PDF manuals with the Claude API that answered 91% of a 22-question test set correctly and refused all 4 unanswerable questions; hybrid BM25 and semantic retrieval raised MRR from 0.748 to 0.898
I stored sentence-transformer embeddings in ChromaDB and combined them with BM25 using Reciprocal Rank Fusion
I measured latency and cost per answer in DocuMind's evaluation: 3.3 s median latency, and a full evaluation run cost $0.44

letter.problems_section: I would help design and test RAG components for your agents, build evaluation sets to measure accuracy, and support data collection and labelling pipelines. I have not used RAGFlow or built agents yet, and I am keen to learn both on a real IoT product.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Heidelberg and can start immediately. As a non-EU student I will agree the internship hours with you so they fit my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
